agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The clone ended in a verified whiteout, so the bundle is retired and live execution remains forbidden.

resolution.observed: The losing Coppertop bundle was retired. The new exact opening checkpoint selects Bushtank Razor Leaf and forbids switches; the next attempt restarts at Clone 1.

findings.observed_fact: Dustox remained at 18 HP before Roost while Ohmnomnom was the only surviving party member at 5 HP.

findings.summary: Ohmnomnom was spent on Bibarel instead of being preserved as the Electric-resistant, poison-immune Eelektrik answer.

resolution.observed: Decision-only replay from the new checkpoint selected Bushtank Razor Leaf for the Bibarel opening, leaving Ohmnomnom untouched at 50/50 for Eelektrik.

findings.observed_fact: Two Sparks removed Bibarel but Super Fang and contact damage reduced Ohmnomnom from 50 to 13 before Eelektrik appeared.

findings.summary: Coppertop was assigned to Eelektrik despite lacking the damage or special bulk to win that matchup.

resolution.observed: Coppertop was swapped into the PC through forward gameplay. Bushtank now leads and the profile assigns full-health Ohmnomnom, not Coppertop, to Eelektrik.

findings.observed_fact: Coppertop dealt 7 with Tackle, took 31 from Shock Wave, and was left at 6 HP against Eelektrik at 47/54.

findings.summary: The forced-switch selector sacrificed Birdlaw and Bugatti into Eelektrik because one-turn survival margin outranked their later finisher roles.

resolution.observed: The new profile routes Croakatoa to Ohmnomnom at Eelektrik and explicitly preserves Birdlaw and Bugatti. The old forced-relay bundle will not be retried.

findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw and Bugatti each entered Eelektrik, attacked twice, and fainted; this removed the reserved Dustox and Sunflora answers before either target appeared.

findings.summary: Croakatoa used three weak Mud Shots into Dustox after the reserved finisher had already been lost.

resolution.observed: The new profile hands Dustox directly from Ohmnomnom to Birdlaw and commits Aerial Ace; it no longer leaves Croakatoa using Mud Shot into Black Sludge recovery.

findings.observed_fact: Each Mud Shot dealt only enough damage for Dustox to return to 48, 44, and 40 HP after Black Sludge while Infestation and Venoshock removed Croakatoa.

findings.summary: The Eelektrik phase consumed four party members across a forced replacement relay instead of using one prepared counter.
findings.observed_fact: Coppertop, Birdlaw, Bugatti, and Croakatoa were used sequentially against the same Eelektrik.

correct_choices: Lildozer's two Bulldozes and priority Ice Shard reduced Ponyta to a safe forced-finish state.
Croakatoa's priority Vacuum Wave was a guaranteed KO on 7-HP Ponyta; Fake Out was legal but not required for safety.
The voluntary-switch anti-spam gates blocked unsafe reversals and repeated no-action switching.
All 26 action outcomes and the terminal whiteout were verified from RAM with no observation mismatch.
agent_review.next_test: Replace Coppertop with boxed Bushtank without rewinding progress. Let Bushtank handle Bibarel, preserve full-health Ohmnomnom for Eelektrik, and preserve Birdlaw/Bugatti for Dustox/Sunflora. Decision-replay the attached opening and forced-switch states before restarting Clone 1.
